java.say: The domain owns the interface BikeLock. It knows no vendor.
A Bike unlocks through its BikeLock, whatever is behind it.
The LockIt adapter translates unlock() to the vendor's unlockBike(id).
The SmartLock adapter translates it to open(number, token).
The factory reads the vendor from the configuration and makes the matching adapter.
An unknown vendor is an error. The factory is the only class that knows which adapters exist.
